name: Shane James Sweeney
headline: Senior QE & Mobile Automation Consultant
meta: 15+ years in test automation · Kennesaw, GA
summary: Quality engineering professional with **15+ years in test automation**, building scalable frameworks for mobile, web, API, and backend systems across banking, insurance, healthcare, and utility products.
Hands-on **Appium automation of iOS and Android** since 2014 on real devices and simulators/emulators (Perfecto, BrowserStack), alongside WebdriverIO, Playwright, and Selenium.

Designs **OOP-based Page Object frameworks** in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, and C#, and integrates them into **CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) with parallel execution, reporting, and environment configuration.
Combines hands-on engineering depth with quality leadership: former Tech QA Manager, mentor, and early adopter of **AI-assisted testing** with GitHub Copilot and Claude.
frameworks: Designed and implemented automation frameworks in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, and Groovy (Geb/Spock) with Appium, WebdriverIO, Playwright, and Selenium, incorporating BDD and TDD practices to enhance test reliability and maintainability.

highlights.label: Automation Impact
highlights.text: Increased automated test coverage from 45% to 80% and cut manual mobile regression from 2 days to 4 hours at Fifth Third Bank.

highlights.label: Quality Strategy
highlights.text: Led UI, API, scale, regression, and PDF validation initiatives across all U.S. counties.

highlights.label: Team Leadership
highlights.text: Mentored junior and senior QA engineers through coaching and documentation, strengthening automation practices.

highlights.label: Delivery & Performance
highlights.text: Migrated CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, cutting regression cycles from 3 days to 6 hours, and ran performance tests with JMeter and BlazeMeter for 10,000+ concurrent users.

highlights.label: Quality Engineering
highlights.text: Used GitHub Copilot and Claude for PR reviews and test scripting, accelerating script development by 30%, with SonarQube enforcing quality gates.
